scope: Read-only inspection of existing metadata/configurations and earlier extracted configuration metadata. No commands, simulations, training, checkpoint selection, model loading, API calls or implementation inspection were performed in this follow-up. Only session audit reports were written.

conclusion.statement: The recorded training/selection source configuration and native Table1 configuration are byte-identical. The Table2 physical-recovery YAML has the same market, default-plant/scenario, reward and handshake settings; its only primary configuration field differences are the three relative-to-absolute data-directory strings.
conclusion.market_price_caution: handshake.rmcp_max=100 is the configured price-normalization scale, not a claim that the mean posted price is 100. The parent-reported realized mean posted price near 25 and asked price near 92 do not, by themselves, demonstrate a price-scale configuration mismatch.
conclusion.causal_limit: The bid-rejection and SOC failures are not diagnosed here. Equal recorded configurations/source identities are not a proof of all runtime constructor arguments or trajectory distributions, and they do not justify substituting a checkpoint.
